name: Ogre's Monocle
summary: In southern Duskwood, Zzarc'Vul wears an immense monocle. Its lens has the exact dimensions Viktori Prism'Antras needs for a stargazing telescope in Darkshire.

sections.title: A Curious Lens
sections.body: Zzarc'Vul, an ogre, wears a huge monocle tailored to his massive stature. When Viktori Prism'Antras of Darkshire began building a stargazing instrument from blueprints by the gnome engineer Cog, ordinary lenses proved too small. Zzarc'Vul's eyewear is the only polished glass in the region with the size and curve needed to focus light through the finished telescope.

sections.title: Prying It from Vul'Gol
sections.body: The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in the shadow of southern Duskwood, where Zzarc'Vul lives among his brute brethren. The brute shows little wish to give up his distinctive accessory. To claim the lens, you must defeat him on his own ground, then carry the glass back to Darkshire so Viktori can turn his gaze to the night skies.

faq.answer: Zzarc'Vul, an ogre in southern Duskwood, carries the monocle at the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound.

faq.q: Why does Viktori Prism'Antras need an ogre's eyepiece?
faq.answer: Viktori Prism'Antras needs an unusually large lens for a telescope built from the gnome Cog's blueprints. Zzarc'Vul's monocle is the only piece of glass in Duskwood that fits.

faq.q: How did an ogre get a giant monocle?
aliases: why does an ogre have a monocle
faq.answer: The account does not explain how Zzarc'Vul acquired the monocle. It says only that he has one large enough for Viktori's telescope.

faq.q: Where is the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound located?
faq.answer: The Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies in the southern hills of Duskwood, south of the main road between Darkshire and the western border.

angles.text: Cog's blueprint shows typical gnomish ambition: using giant eyewear when precision-ground lenses are unavailable in the field.
Recovering the lens removes a dangerous brute from the southern woods and helps Darkshire's beleaguered citizens find solace in the stars.
